notes: Fight Victories are now universal across Adventure/Single Player, Multiplayer/Group Battle, Group Tournament, individual Tournament, 3rd Place, Grand Finals games, and Class Boss victories
Existing student win counters are now labeled Fight Victories
Adventure tries to match the selected character to the shared student roster by name so its victory updates the same student record
Class Boss victory gives +1 Fight Victory to every participating student
Group Battle strategy keyboard controls: Left/1 Attack, Up/2 Heal, Right/3 Defend, Down/4 Switch
After Switch or KO replacement opens, number keys 1–9 select the displayed living teammate
Strategy buttons now show their keyboard hints directly on screen
30 HP damage cap, Group Rankings, Group Tournament, Teacher Forfeit, and manual KO replacement remain included
